resources.string:
1. Choose an AI provider, paste its API key below and tap Save.
2. Turn on the floating button (below).
3. In any app (WeChat, WhatsApp, Gmail…), type your message and pause for a moment.
4. The professional version pops up above the keyboard. Tap Use, and send.

You can also tap the ✨ Pro button any time, or select text and choose "Make Professional" from the menu.
Always write the result in English

Tap the button, find "Pro Writer floating button" (it may be under Downloaded apps or Installed apps), and switch it on.

If Android says it's a restricted setting: go to Settings → Apps → Pro Writer → ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, then try again.

On Xiaomi phones, also set Pro Writer's Battery saver to "No restrictions" so the button keeps working.
Show the professional version automatically when I stop typing
Your draft is sent to the AI each time you pause. Turn this off to send it only when you tap ✨ Pro.
Type a message, e.g. \"hi sir i cant come tomorow my bike is not working\"
Copied. Long-press the message box and tap Paste.

Shows a ✨ Pro button above your keyboard. When you stop typing, Pro Writer sends the text you are typing to the AI provider you chose and offers a professional version that you can use with one tap. It never reads password fields and does nothing until you type.
